scope: Paired plan-review source metadata preparation on Desktop and Managed hosts
evidence_policy: Current candidate-bound executed checks and actual separate-invocation review govern component completion. This report supplies no executed or parent pass.
controls: Strict models.preview-source codecs capture exact host/workspace/qualified model/optional immutable commit. The application owner captures actor/client/context references before awaits and refuses replacement, mutation, revocation, malformed inputs and unavailable policy before provider work or egress.

Both reader compositions require plan-review purpose and workspace/model-read/provider-credential-use authority before lazy ownership and throughout the attempt. Trusted provider controls fence SDK/credential waits and each request/page; immediate synchronous currentness checks at owner/SDK/key/request/egress call sites close nested-microtask gaps. One active attempt remains owned until real settlement.

New provider access needs explicit modelSourceRead consent. Saved Desktop clients and pending pre-permission pairings keep earlier operations without an authority-expanding migration. Updated trusted native consent may grant source/key use to new plan-review pairings only; malformed saved values deny. Managed access defaults off and requires the explicit operator switch plus exact issuer-verified plan client, with the same capability required at host and API boundaries. Request/token fields cannot self-grant it.

A separate Desktop HTTP read-lifetime fence denies source work after disconnect, including held authorization. Existing accepted conversations retain independent task authority and are not canceled by this read-only fence.

The private source default remains20seconds. The public profile narrows it to4seconds inside existing5second Desktop/SDK and12second Managed route limits; no transport or resource guard is raised. Slow sources can remain unavailable without hidden retry or replacement.

The separate lazy source owner reuses existing secure provider credentials and no active Model/runtime/task/file-discovery fallback. Native pairing lists source/key-use permission and retains separate approvals for downloads and runs.

Host/API/SDK boundaries independently normalize exact-target replies and recompute manifestDigest from metadata. Returned file hashes, licensing and formats remain provider-declared information; byte verification, license rights, loadability, memory fit and output quality are unperformed.

One plan-review-only aisb_model_workflow source selector preserves finite discovery:31 Desktop plan tools and24 Managed plan tools, both within32. Saved inventory remains in provider-free aisb_model_metadata. The source tool discloses external provider/key use and sets the open-world annotation.
controlled_observations: Focused request/application/provider cases cover malformed/proxy/accessor input, copied targets, exact metadata digest, current actor/client/host/context, denied policy, revoked credential waits, pagination and narrowed deadline with late-work fencing.

Focused composition cases use both actual host readers and the actual application/installed provider SDK against synthetic fetch responses. They cover ordinary discovery, provider/credential policy, stopped lazy/credential boundaries, legacy consent, nested-microtask withdrawal, caller mutation and altered digest/private/readiness replies.

Thirty-two focused registry, Managed identity and actual pinned-loopback tests pass outside the sandbox. A real disconnected Desktop request held in application authorization denies lazy ownership, SDK initialization, key access and provider requests while keeping the paired registration current. Old/pending clients retain old authority; explicit new consent and Managed opt-in are separate. Existing accepted-conversation disconnect behavior remains covered.

Authenticated Managed route and actual SDK/stdio fixtures exercise source selection, independent target/digest checks, invalid source fields, metadata-only licensing and ordinary protocol compatibility. These are controlled local protocol fixtures, not physical application/provider/model outcomes.

The canonical census changes only one existing Desktop tool-list source fact. Its original committed witness, all scenarios/execution statuses and historical qualification gaps remain. Exact legacy-view tests authenticate both prior Git source and the single factual delta; no UI pass is created.

qualification_limits: No live provider response-time, physical Desktop/Managed app, actual model download/load, training, generation, hardware or native cleanup qualification is claimed by these source fixtures.
An immutable revision and metadata digest do not prove authentic supplier bytes, complete shards/index references, safe local formats, license rights, compatibility, resources or quality.
A timed-out dependency keeps the same source instance unavailable until actual settlement. Source preview creates no task, effect approval, model acquisition, runtime or saved record.

Manifest-bound approved acquisition/status, training/evaluation, generation/reveals and actual-host/model outcomes remain I7 obligations. Existing accepted ordinary accuracy results and genuine native/offload/security gaps remain intact.
